name: Constructed zinc-blende CdSe reference
phaseScope: Constructed zinc-blende CdSe reference reusing the existing site geometry: ideal fractional basis and a = 6.077 angstrom from the cited epitaxial-film literature. This is not a refined nanocrystal, fitted lattice parameter, surface or core/shell interface. The CIF is an explicit eight-site P1 export of the ideal F-43m prototype, not a measured P1 phase.

lattice_parameter.citation: N. Samarth et al., Growth of cubic (zinc blende) CdSe by molecular beam epitaxy, Applied Physics Letters 54 (1989), 2680–2682
lattice_parameter.note: 6.077 angstrom was measured for CdSe epitaxial layers; this prototype uses it as a bulk-scale lattice reference, not as a measured value for the chosen 3 nm quantum dots.

source.adaptation: Only schema conversion and Cartesian multiplication of the existing fractional sites; no fitted or newly retrieved coordinates.

renderingNotes: Fractional coordinates multiply by a=6.077 to obtain Cartesian angstrom coordinates.
Nearest Cd-Se distance is sqrt(3)*a/4, approximately 2.6314 angstrom.
A 3 nm spherical crop uses radius 15 angstrom and is illustrative; stoichiometry and dangling bonds at the crop are not a physical surface model.
Do not label surface ligands, defects, strain, reconstructions or electronic wavefunctions as measured by this geometry.
